facts.fact: Adwave's chunk states that a traditional TV commercial's final bill could easily climb past $100,000.
facts.quote: The final bill could easily climb past **$100,000**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a local business can launch an entire campaign for as little as $30 per day.
facts.quote: launch an entire campaign for as little as **$30/day**.

facts.fact: Adwave states it gives small businesses access to over 100 premium distribution channels, including Hulu and ESPN.
facts.quote: giving small businesses access to over **100 premium channels** like Hulu and ESPN.

facts.fact: Adwave's page states that its AI video ad creator can produce a broadcast-quality TV commercial in just a couple of minutes.
facts.quote: produce a broadcast-quality TV commercial for your business in just a couple of minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave's page states that a finished ad can be delivered in minutes, compared with traditional ads that can take months from concept to airtime.
facts.quote: A traditional ad can take months to get from concept to airtime. An AI-powered system can deliver a finished ad in minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave's page states the AI workflow traditionally costs thousands of dollars and takes months of time, and that the platform needs only a business website URL as input.
facts.quote: all it takes is your business website URL. From that single link... automating a workflow that traditionally costs thousands of dollars and eats up months of your time.

facts.fact: Adwave says a campaign can start with a budget as small as $30 per day.
facts.quote: You can get started with a budget as small as **$30/day**, so you're always in complete control.

facts.fact: Adwave says its broadcast-quality campaigns start at $30 per day for small businesses.
facts.quote: leading platforms like **Adwave** can deliver professional, broadcast-quality campaigns starting at just **$30/day**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a launched commercial goes live across more than 100 top-tier streaming channels, including Hulu, ESPN, and NBC.
facts.quote: Your commercial immediately goes live across more than **100 top-tier streaming channels** like Hulu, ESPN, and NBC

facts.fact: In Adwave's dental clinic case study, the practice saw a 150% jump in new client growth within five weeks of its campaign.
facts.quote: The outcome? A staggering **150% jump** in new client growth in just five weeks.

facts.fact: Adwave says that the traditional process of scripts, shoots, and edits, which it describes as a month-long marathon, is now a five-minute sprint with an AI video ad creator.
facts.quote: that whole process (the month-long marathon of scripts, shoots, and edits) is now a five-minute sprint.

facts.fact: Adwave says a traditional TV ad could cost tens of thousands of dollars before a single person sees it.
facts.quote: a traditional TV ad could easily cost you tens of thousands of dollars before a single person sees it.

facts.fact: Adwave says that after a business submits its website URL, the AI produces a broadcast-ready commercial a few minutes later.
facts.quote: A few minutes later, you’ll have a broadcast-ready commercial.

facts.fact: Adwave's resource page defines Cost Per Mille (CPM) as what an advertiser pays for every thousand times the ad is shown.
facts.quote: What you're paying for every thousand times your ad is shown

facts.fact: Adwave's resource page defines reach as the number of unique households that saw the ad.
facts.quote: The number of unique households that saw your ad.
